# async-test-lib (module)

The library itself — annotations, config, the N×M runner, the JUnit extension, the 135 detectors,
the SPI and the reporting pipeline. This is the artifact consumers depend on.

Guardrails below are generated by vibetags from this module's own annotations only. The reactor-root
`CLAUDE.md` carries the merged view across all three modules; this file is the one that matters when
you are editing here.

    </element>
    <element path="se.deversity.asynctest.runner.ConcurrencyRunner">
      <sensitivity>Critical</sensitivity>
      <note>Core stress-test execution engine. The CyclicBarrier pattern forces maximum thread contention. Timeout logic and AsyncTestContext install/uninstall are carefully calibrated — subtle changes introduce flaky tests or missed detector activations.</note>
    </element>
